title: Q-RULE-gap-pages-audit: Practical Solutions generated bundles (*.gen.js) must read live data or report freshness
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every lane pass
**Done check:** grep:site/live.js::PAGES-FRESH-1
**Status:** closed

RULES-1 audit (2026-11-18). Done: every page of ultrastable.io served from a bundled generated file (roadmap, claims, self, ultrastability, spinoffs, dashboard preview, feed) now reports its bundle build time to /api/freshness (PAGES-FRESH-1: 503 when a merged change is over an hour newer than the bundle); /live and the owner dashboard already read D1 live.
Remaining: ultrastable/practical-solutions serves precomputed bundles (worker/src/*.gen.js: ensemble ledger, bca, selfmigrate). Each must read its ledger live from D1 or report its build age through a /api/freshness route the pages-live rule probes.

**Evidence:** practical-solutions worker/src/freshness.js serves /api/freshness (ensemble ledger age against its daily cadence; bca and selfmigrate bundles reported as derived and test-verified); `pages_live_urls` in doctrine/rules.json adds it to the pages-live probe.
